note: Benchmark manifest for `python -m nctool compare` (core/conversion-versioning): the FIXED set of scans + recipes two builds are compared over. Cases name frames; the asset inventory (paths + sha256) stays in <asset-root>/manifest.json, which `compare run` resolves them through -- there is deliberately only one asset inventory. Recipe paths are repo-relative and reuse the frozen real-scan recipes so a comparison runs the same parameters the verification harness does.

fixtures.note: The committed decoder fixtures -- tiny (502x462), no Drive assets needed, so `compare` is runnable and testable on any checkout. Covers both input formats (HDR 48-bit, HDRi 64-bit) and, across cases, the default sigmoid curve, the exponential curve (explicitly, since it is no longer the default), `simple` reconstruction, and f32 (HDR) output. This is the set to use for a determinism / zero-diff check.

rolls.note: The real-scan benchmark: exposed frames from the Ektar and Phoenix rolls (the two rolls docs/reports/v0-baseline.md was measured on), each with its roll's frozen recipe from scripts/real-scan-verify/recipes/ -- so the roll-fixed Dmin/Dmax come from that roll's own calibration rather than a per-frame estimate. Requires the nc-assets Drive folder via ../nc-assets plus a generated manifest.json.
